capabilities.claim: EconomicObject schemas and deterministic semantic kernel preserve canonical Noema invariants over replayable fixtures.
limitations: Deterministic fixture proof is not itself proof of correctness over arbitrary real-world economic sources.

capabilities.claim: Noema AI is proposal-only and deterministic promotion policy prevents unsupported model output from becoming canonical authority in the tested benchmark/integrity cases.
limitations: This does not claim production model accuracy on arbitrary live RWA documents.
The benchmark proves the fixed promotion-safety experiment claim only.

capabilities.claim: The selected public runtime is X Layer testnet chain ID 1952 and required runtime surfaces are reachable.
limitations: A live network probe does not establish economic-source authority.

capabilities.claim: NoemaRegistry can be deployed on X Layer testnet, commit canonical object/evidence roots, emit traceable events, preserve append-only history, and support direct state readback.
limitations: The cited v1/v2 live history proof used explicitly labelled registry mechanics/demo fixtures, not a Phase 2 real-RWA evidence object.

capabilities.claim: The deployed NoemaRegistry source was verified through the OKLink X Layer Foundry verifier without an API key.
ERC-8021 Builder Code attribution can be appended to a Noema registry transaction without mutating canonical ABI calldata semantics or object/evidence roots.
limitations: This proves attribution transport semantics, not economic correctness.

capabilities.claim: HTTP, document, and EVM acquisition boundaries exist and terminate at canonical SourceSnapshot/SourceFailure contracts.
limitations: Phase 2 has not yet captured a release-grade multi-source real-RWA evidence pack through these adapters.

capabilities.claim: A real multi-source RWA case has been resolved end-to-end into a canonical Evidence-Bounded Economic Object.
limitations: The required Phase 2 real-RWA release scenario has not yet been captured and proven.

capabilities.claim: A deterministic treasury mandate has been evaluated over the selected real RWA candidate set with fully traversable receipts and evidence lineage.
limitations: The mandate engine is deterministic, but the Phase 2 real-candidate application proof is pending.

capabilities.claim: At least one X Layer commitment corresponds to an EconomicObject built from captured real RWA evidence rather than a demo fixture.
limitations: Existing live registry proof is transport/mechanics proof over labelled fixtures. The Phase 2 real-evidence commitment is pending.

capabilities.claim: Two genuine dated source states produce a replayable vN -> vN+1 material-change cycle with re-verification, re-evaluation, event, and notification.
limitations: The behavior is proven over canonical fixtures; the Phase 2 genuine-source-state application proof is pending.

capabilities.claim: REST, SDK, and MCP projections preserve canonical Noema semantics in deterministic parity tests.
limitations: The canonical machine surfaces are not yet proven as one deployed Phase 2 release runtime.

capabilities.claim: The Noema UI/view-model layer is presentation-only and preserves canonical semantics in deterministic parity tests.
limitations: The Phase 2 live-RWA release demo has not yet been packaged against the deployed runtime.

capabilities.claim: The complete Phase 2 live-RWA release candidate has been replayed at one exact commit with a durable terminal receipt.
limitations: Terminal Phase 2 convergence proof is pending.

capabilities.claim: Noema uses X Layer EAS as a release dependency.
limitations: EAS remains conditional and outside the current MVP/Phase 2 dependency graph.

capabilities.claim: Noema owns trading, lending, settlement, financing, or autonomous execution.
limitations: Execution authority belongs downstream by Product Truth.
